title: Northern Lights seen as far south as London
summary: Rupert Sheldrake tells of Northern Lights seen as far south as London, about 2024 at London, Southern England, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the northern lights were seen as far south as London right here actually I didn't see them myself cuz it was cloudy

plain: Rupert Sheldrake, a British scientist, mentions on Jesse Michels's podcast that in 2024 the northern lights, the glowing coloured skies usually seen near the Arctic, were spotted as far south as London. He says he didn't see them himself because it was cloudy. He brings it up as an example of unusual things happening in the sky.
